content.text:
pixelart_workbench — one command per call; `<command> -h` lists its arguments.

author, edit and look:
  inspect  frame sheets of an image, or a zoomed crop with its exact colours
  edit  guarded pixel operations on an image or animation; returns a new image id
  draw  render a layered drawing or animation from a recipe; revise or inspect one by id
  describe  a contract, or the command list

check and explain a drawing:
  lint  pixel-art findings with owners and overlays
  measure  bbox, centroid, widths, colors, owners
  explain  resolved geometry per node/command without building
  clusters  same-colour cluster map
  parts  visualize a job's source partition (each part coloured, unassigned and double-claimed pixels flagged)
  silhouette  readability packet: silhouette, inverse, grey, mirrored, 1x/2x on light/mid/dark backgrounds
  motion  temporal report: deltas, seam, holds, flashes, speed, arc, area drift per node
  storyboard  render the frames a reviewer should look at, with reasons
  reveal  pixels of the rest silhouette that articulation leaves uncovered (needs underpaint)
  crop  export a small region as text rows + legend for hand editing (with a fingerprint for guarded paste)
  sweep  render variants of one craft op (e.g. shade band=1,2,3) as candidates plus one comparison sheet

any image:
  score  0-100 pixel-art discipline score with a breakdown
  extract-palette  extract a palette and ramp proposals from reference art
  repair  deterministic cleanup: regrid,defringe,snap,stray,holes,deflicker

improve a drawing (each returns a new drawing id):
  shade  ramp shading toward/away from a light, emitted as a guarded patch decision
  selout  selective outlining, emitted as a guarded patch decision
  reoutline  move a node's outline outside (or inside) its fill; needs --bake
  clean-lines  erase doubled corner pixels on 1px outlines; needs --bake
  aa  interior anti-aliasing at outline staircase corners
  mirror  make one node the exact pixel mirror of another; needs --bake
  cluster  identify the same-colour cluster under a pixel; recolor/delete/nudge it with a fingerprint guard
  paste  guarded replacement of a cropped region from edited rows (node-local, baked)

two drawings:
  compare  changed pixels between two runs

no subject:
  palette  generate hue-shifted ramps from base colours

contracts: `describe start | draw | animation | motion | scenes | edits | paint | outline | review`; engine details: `describe change_operations | coordinates | decisions | draw_commands | job_conveniences | lint_rules | ramps`.
